credits.title: Josephine
credits.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

credits.title: Princeton's in the Mix
credits.overview: When the wealthy mother of a high schooler discovers that her son can get extra time on the SAT if he gets injured, things spiral out of control.

credits.title: Promises of Snow
credits.overview: An FBI agent with a past suspects a young girl arrested for prostitution to be a victim of sex trafficking. Her investigation reveals a startling connection between the two of them.

credits.title: Rendezvous
credits.overview: Directed by Bolaji Tijani-Qudus. Rendezvous is about urban dwellers who congregate at a local bar and the surprising details of their lives are revealed as the drinks flow. "Cheers" meet "Sex in the City"

credits.title: Pale Blue Balloons
credits.overview: Dave is a bad cop fighting a deadly heroin addiction while working a case deep inside the mafia.
